name: Trihex Plain
short_description: Trihex Pavers are heavy-duty interlocking concrete pavers designed for high-traffic areas. Featuring a unique hexagonal shape that eliminates visible seams, these 80mm-thick pavers deliver superior load-bearing capacity, weather resistance, and rapid installation for driveways, streetscapes, and industrial zones.
description:
Engineered for demanding environments, Trihex Pavers combine robust performance with aesthetic versatility. Their patented hexagonal design (186mm W × 92mm D × 80mm H) interlocks seamlessly to create continuous, crack-resistant surfaces without repetitive lines. Crafted from high-density concrete, they withstand freeze-thaw cycles, de-icing salts, and vehicular loads exceeding 3,500 kg axles. Compatible with permeable systems like Ecotrihex® for integrated stormwater management, these pavers offer textures ranging from smooth to shot-blasted for customized slip resistance.

Key Innovations:

  • Seamless Aesthetics: Hexagonal geometry enables fluid patterns ideal for large-scale projects (e.g., Sydney Olympic Park).

  • Hybrid Permeability: Integrates with permeable Ecotrihex® pavers for eco-compliant drainage.

  • Machine-Lay Ready: Optimized for mechanical installation, reducing labor costs by 30% .

  • UV-Stable Colors: Iron oxide pigments retain vibrancy in oatmeal, charcoal, grey, and red finishes

name: Interlocking Red 60mm Pavers
short_description: Interlocking Red 60mm Pavers deliver vibrant aesthetics with industrial-grade durability. Featuring precision-engineered interlocking edges and UV-stable red concrete, these pavers withstand heavy traffic, freeze-thaw cycles, and harsh weather. Ideal for driveways, plazas, and high-impact zones.
description:
Engineered for commercial resilience, Interlocking Red 60mm Pavers combine bold color retention and structural robustness. The interlocking design creates load-distributing rigidity, while high-density concrete (25–35 MPa tensile strength) ensures resistance to cracking, de-icing salts, and temperatures from -30°C to 65°C. UV-inhibited pigments maintain the rich red hue for decades, and the uniform dimensions enable rapid installation in herringbone or stack-bond patterns.

Key Innovations:

  • Shear-Key Interlock: Geometric edges prevent shifting under loads up to 3,000 kg axles.

  • Weather Armor: ≤5% water absorption and freeze-thaw resilience.

  • Eco-Options: Permeable joint compatibility reduces stormwater runoff.

Applications: Commercial driveways, parking lots, industrial pathways, and municipal plazas.

name: Cassablanca Plain
short_description: Cassablanca Pavers deliver old-world European elegance with modern concrete durability. Featuring a large-format design (up to 24″x36″) and subtle tumbled texture, these pavers replicate weathered stone patinas in blended earth tones. Ideal for driveways, courtyards, and commercial spaces requiring slip-resistant, freeze-thaw-proof surfaces.
description:
Transport your hardscape to the Mediterranean with Cassablanca Pavers—meticulously engineered to emulate centuries-old cobblestone charm with contemporary performance. Crafted from high-density concrete (8,000–10,000 PSI), these pavers feature:

  • Authentic Vintage Aesthetics: Softly tumbled edges and multi-tonal color blends (Terra Cotta, Sandalwood, Graphite) that hide dirt and wear.

  • Commercial-Grade Resilience: Withstands freeze-thaw cycles (-30°F to 150°F), de-icing salts, and 12,000+ PSI vehicle loads (HD2 technology).

  • Safety & Accessibility: Non-slip, textured finish (V3–V4 DIN slip rating) and ADA-compliant flat surfaces.

  • Eco-Engineered: 23% recycled materials; permeable joint options for stormwater management.

Applications: Driveways, pedestrian plazas, resort courtyards, and historic restorations.
